title: 첫 출근 인사: 새 동료에게 나를 소개해요
objective: Introduce yourself to a new team and use -던데요.
summary: On her first day, a new employee introduces herself to a coworker and shares her first impressions of the office.
setting: A marketing team's office, 9 a.m. on Lina's first day.

task.title: Practice first-day expressions
task.line: Use the dialogue and the word list to change, choose, order, or write the Korean in each item.

words.meaning: ending for sharing something you saw or felt yourself earlier, with surprise or admiration ('…was really …!')
words.exampleMeaning: I saw the meeting room earlier, and it was really clean!

words.meaning: to start working (somewhere, because it was decided)
words.example: 다음 달부터 부산 지점에서 일하게 됐어요.
words.exampleMeaning: I'm going to work at the Busan branch from next month.

words.meaning: I look forward to working with you (polite set phrase)
words.exampleMeaning: I'm new, so I still have a lot to learn, but I look forward to working with you.

words.meaning: to be a relief; to be lucky

words.exampleMeaning: Weekends are fine too, so call me anytime.
Let me introduce my friend to you.

dialogue.korean: 안녕하세요. 오늘부터 마케팅팀에서 일하게 된 리나 첸입니다. 잘 부탁드립니다.
dialogue.meaning: Hello. I'm Lina Chen, and I'm joining the marketing team today. I look forward to working with you.

dialogue.korean: 반가워요. 오늘 아침에 회사 찾아오기 어렵지 않았어요?
dialogue.meaning: Nice to meet you. Was it hard to find the office this morning?

dialogue.korean: 아니요, 생각보다 가깝던데요. 지하철역에서 5분밖에 안 걸렸어요.
dialogue.meaning: No, it was closer than I thought! It only took five minutes from the subway station.

dialogue.korean: 다행이네요. 건물을 처음 봤을 때 어땠어요?
dialogue.meaning: That's good to hear. What did you think of the building when you first saw it?

dialogue.korean: 로비가 정말 넓고 밝던데요. 깜짝 놀랐어요.
dialogue.meaning: The lobby was really big and bright! I was surprised.
If there's anything you don't know, ask me anytime.

dialogue.korean: 우리 팀 분위기 좋아요. 점심 같이 먹으면서 다른 분들도 소개해 드릴게요.
dialogue.meaning: Our team has a good atmosphere. I'll introduce you to the others over lunch.

exercises: Change the word in brackets to the -던데요 form: ① 회사 식당 음식이 정말 (맛있다). ② 휴게실이 생각보다 (작다).
Fill in the blank with 다행이에요, 소개해, or 언제든지: ① 지하철이 늦게 왔지만 지각하지 않아서 ____. ② 제가 과장님께 ____ 드릴게요. ③ 저는 오후에 계속 사무실에 있으니까 ____ 오세요.
Put the words in order to make a self-introduction: 일하게 / 오늘부터 / 김하늘입니다 / 디자인팀에서 / 된
Answer in Korean with -던데요 and the word 조용하다: 사무실 근처는 어땠어요?
answers: ① 다행이에요 ② 소개해 ③ 언제든지
오늘부터 디자인팀에서 일하게 된 김하늘입니다. (디자인팀에서 오늘부터 일하게 된 김하늘입니다.)
근처가 정말 조용하던데요. (사무실 근처가 생각보다 조용하던데요.)
